availability.notion: post-session artifact; use source order and completion, not date alone

construction.author: Codex assistant
construction.input_scope: entire one completed source session only

theme: Work appraisal, self-doubt, relationships and a helpful creative outlet
summary_text: The seeker was disappointed by the previous day's performance review: their boss called the work adequate, which led them to question whether they were doing a good job. They linked being on edge to an unspecified past incident with an old boss, worried about a friend and not burdening them, and hoped the distress would not affect their relationship with Jack, which had had ups and downs. The supporter validated the disappointment, separated the appraisal from personal worth, encouraged attending to the seeker's own needs and suggested communicating feelings. The seeker intended to talk to Jack that night and said that being open seemed helpful in their relationship; the planned conversation itself had not yet occurred in the account. When asked about the painting hobby, the seeker said it helped as a creative outlet, even for a short time. They appreciated the listening and encouragement and intended to take things one step at a time; the session did not report a later work or relationship outcome.

claim_source_ledger.text: The seeker was disappointed by the previous day's performance review: their boss called the work adequate, which led them to question whether they were doing a good job.

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: I had my performance review yesterday, and it didn't go as well as I hoped.

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: She said my work was 'adequate,' but I was hoping for something more positive.

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: Yeah, it just made me question if I'm even doing a good job.

claim_source_ledger.text: They linked being on edge to an unspecified past incident with an old boss, worried about a friend and not burdening them, and hoped the distress would not affect their relationship with Jack, which had had ups and downs.

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: I know, but after the whole incident with my old boss, I'm just on edge about everything.

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: And I keep thinking about how my friend is doing. I don't want to burden them with my stuff.

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: Thanks, I just hope this doesn't affect my relationship with Jack. We've had our ups and downs.

claim_source_ledger.text: The supporter validated the disappointment, separated the appraisal from personal worth, encouraged attending to the seeker's own needs and suggested communicating feelings.

evidence.speaker: supporter
evidence.quote: It's tough not getting the feedback you were expecting, especially when you put in so much effort.

evidence.speaker: supporter
evidence.quote: It's understandable that you're feeling this way. This doesn't define your worth or capabilities.

evidence.speaker: supporter
evidence.quote: You're such a caring person, Sarah. It's okay to focus on yourself too.

evidence.speaker: supporter
evidence.quote: Remember, Jack cares about you a lot. It's important to communicate how you're feeling.

claim_source_ledger.text: The seeker intended to talk to Jack that night and said that being open seemed helpful in their relationship; the planned conversation itself had not yet occurred in the account.

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: I think I'll talk to him tonight. Being open seems to help us a lot.

claim_source_ledger.text: When asked about the painting hobby, the seeker said it helped as a creative outlet, even for a short time.

evidence.speaker: supporter
evidence.quote: That sounds like a great idea. How about the painting hobby you started? Is that helping?

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: It does help. It's nice to have a creative outlet, even if it's just for a bit.

claim_source_ledger.text: They appreciated the listening and encouragement and intended to take things one step at a time; the session did not report a later work or relationship outcome.

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: Yeah, I just have to remind myself of that. Thank you for listening and just being here.

evidence.speaker: supporter
evidence.quote: Anytime, Sarah. I'm really proud of how you're handling everything.

evidence.speaker: seeker
evidence.quote: That means a lot. I'll try to take things one step at a time.

evidence.speaker: supporter
evidence.quote: Exactly. You've got this, and I'm always here if you need to talk.

quality_self_review: Resolves It does help using the immediately preceding painting question.
Does not invent details of the old boss incident or the friend's problem.
Separates the subjective appraisal of openness from the intended conversation that night; does not infer a specific past trial or established outcome.
Preserves work concern and relationship concern rather than keeping only the coping action.
